stories.title: Production voice AI agents with CRM integrations (Avoca)
stories.situation: At Avoca, customer-facing voice agents needed to integrate reliably with CRM systems and downstream business workflows.
stories.task: Build production-ready voice AI agents and the backend tool layer they needed for contextual, real-time business data access.
stories.action: Designed, developed, and deployed voice AI agents using VAPI and ElevenLabs, built custom MCP servers and REST/RAG-backed tools for CRM integrations, and created agent-to-agent simulations to stress-test flows before release.
stories.result: Shipped production conversational workflows with better contextual access, stronger QA coverage, and reduced manual testing effort for voice-agent releases.

stories.title: LiveKit/Dify voice agents with SIP and evals (Salescode.ai)
stories.situation: At Salescode.ai, production conversational AI voice agents needed to work reliably over real-time telephony.
stories.task: Build voice-agent workflows and testing infrastructure that could validate quality and reliability before deployment.
stories.action: Built voice agents using LiveKit and Dify, integrated them with SIP providers like Twilio, designed Opik/Langfuse-based evaluation and testing workflows, and created agent-to-agent simulations to stress-test behavior.
stories.result: Improved confidence before deployment by testing conversational quality, reliability, and edge cases with traceable evals and simulations.

stories.title: Mobile E2E testing for digital health platform (Elyx Life)
stories.situation: At Elyx Life, critical user journeys on a cross-platform digital health app needed reliable coverage before release.
stories.task: Own product features end to end and improve regression confidence across iOS and Android flows.
stories.action: Implemented features from requirements through production release and developed Maestro E2E flows covering critical mobile journeys on both iOS and Android.
stories.result: Improved release confidence by catching regressions in important user flows before production.

stories.title: Multimodal RAG + LoRA fine-tuning (Bosch)
stories.situation: A use case required generating image-based outputs grounded in retrieved context.
stories.task: Build multimodal RAG and adapt vision-language models to the domain.
stories.action: Engineered a multimodal RAG pipeline for image-based outputs and fine-tuned blip-2 and idefics-9b using LoRA on custom datasets with PyTorch.
stories.result: Delivered domain-adapted multimodal generation with parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

stories.title: Real-time Speech Translator (personal project)
stories.situation: Wanted seamless cross-language spoken communication in the browser.
stories.task: Build a full-stack real-time speech translator.
stories.action: Implemented WebSocket connections for real-time transport and used the Web Audio API for efficient audio capture/processing.
stories.result: Shipped a working live translator (realtime-speech-translator.netlify.app). Demonstrates hands-on real-time browser audio + streaming skills.
